This video is the first in a series I’m creating to share practical information every adult child should know as their parents age. In Part One, I walk through the 3 essential documents you should have in place before a health crisis happens; documents that can save time, stress, and heartache when it matters most.
My hope is that this series helps other families avoid unnecessary confusion during already difficult moments.

White Bean Chicken Chili Recipe
Ingredients:
2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts
2 cans white northern beans, drained
1 can cream of chicken soup
2 cans of chicken broth
2 cans of corn
1 can chopped green chiles
1/2 cup of water
2 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
pepper jack cheese, shredded

Directions:
1. Place uncooked chicken breasts in the crockpot.
2. Add all of the remaining ingredients to your crockpot and gently mix together.
3. Cook on high for approximately 4 hours or low 6-7 hours.
4. Before serving shred the pieces of chicken into bite size pieces.
5. Serve with some crushed tortilla chips and shredded pepper jack cheese on top.
